cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: The Plan Gets Better
cards.instruction: Celebrate every setback as proof that the scheme is becoming more sophisticated, selective, or impossible to detect.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. The alley's blocked. Excellent: our secret proposal picnic just got harder to discover.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm carrying your table. We have to use the main road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. Better camouflage. Everyone will assume we're moving house.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Your girlfriend's coming down the road.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Wonderful. Now she can carry the chairs without suspecting romance. The disguise gets more convincing.

mechanism: A treats its pupil failed stealth route as increasingly sophisticated camouflage, coaching the helper into using the surprise recipient as unwitting cover.
confusable: Not saying every event was secretly planned: A celebrates setbacks as improvements to the scheme being adapted now.
comparison: Improved public camouflage versus dwindling guest list reframed as selectivity.
